about: Fictional people and post images for the sample tour. Every image was generated with Canva's AI image generator in the founder's Canva account on 9 November 2026. None of them shows a real person. They are used only inside the sample tour and in landing page screenshots of the tour, which are captioned as sample data with fictional people.
